skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic viewpoints of Marxist-Leninist theory on working class and its historical mission.
Grasp the content, manifestations, and significance of the historical mission of the working class in the current context.
Comprehend basic viewpoints of Marxist-Leninist theory on socialism and the transitional period towards socialism.
Recognize the essence of democratic socialism and socialist state in general and specifically in Vietnam.
Understand the social structure, class alliance, and layers during the transition to socialism.
Analyze ethnic and religious issues during the transition to socialism.
Examine family issues during the transition to socialism.
Apply research methodologies to analyze the historical mission of the working class and other theoretical issues.
Ability to work independently and in groups to solve problems.
Capacity for independent learning and self-study.
Ability to apply learned knowledge to explain political and social issues in contemporary life.
Collaborate effectively with peers in group projects.
Demonstrate responsibility and accountability in assigned tasks.
